letter.title: Hi, I'm Amiya_desi
letter.intro: I'm Amiya_desi. This page gathers projects, work, notes from the process, and useful public links.

sections.heading: Creative practice
paragraphs: Games: From small experiments and game jams to longer projects, I document how ideas take shape in playable builds.
Websites and tools: I build personal sites, GeoScore, and browser tools—turning real problems into things people can use and share.
Self-hosting: I use Docker, VPSs, and Cloudflare to deploy and maintain personal services, and keep the lessons public.
Content and workflows: I write articles, make videos, curate resources, and use tools like n8n to organize and share them—leaving more time for making things and talking with people.

sections.heading: Projects and milestones
sections.intro: These projects represent different stages of my work. Each project page has the latest status.

items.text: WakeUpAtTheBorder: A Godot game combining puzzles, dialogue, and combat. It won second place in the themed track of GodotHub's third Jam; see the project page and winner list for details.
DelayTrace: A Godot game about time delay, recorded actions, and replay. It was one of my favorite recent game-jam projects and has a playable public build.
TimeRewindLinker: A puzzle experiment built around rewinding time, replaying actions, and connecting the player with echoes of the past.
Enhanced Save System: A modular Godot save plugin with GDScript and C# implementations.
GeoScore: A public-web SEO/GEO audit tool that turns page evidence into checks and practical improvement suggestions.
Mio's Window Wanderer: A multi-window narrative prototype I helped create, exploring window navigation and dialogue.

sections.heading: Updates
paragraphs: Projects, work, and related notes are added as they develop.

sections.heading: Find me and stay in touch
paragraphs: I usually go by Amiya_desi, and my GitHub username is Amiyadesi.

signature.ps: P.S. If anything in this letter resonates with you, feel free to leave a note in the guestbook.
